product.name: Room of Days
product.promise: A warm, physical room answers ordinary movement with restrained clasps; the rare Paired Return is an earned detail rather than everyday noise.
owner_quotes: i like when there's a rhythm and it feels melodic.
sounds really great but can you make the clicking melodic variations sound better overall when clicking around?

avoid: a notification jingle on every tap
brittle sparkle, audible room tail, or synthetic sine purity
letting the approved return escape its rarity gate

shared_dna.transient: The approved v3 X contact and 8.5 ms clasp remain the audible causal event.
shared_dna.body: All ordinary events use the complete v3 X core selected from its five-take family.
shared_dna.harmonic_field: Phone-approved bounded D-major-pentatonic D5/A5/E5/D5 after an active stable-screen eligibility gate; ordinary X has no pitch token.
shared_dna.texture: The filtered v3 micro-grain and inharmonic body remain unchanged; v4's short modal stem is only the rare signature layer.
shared_dna.space: Ordinary cues are centered and dry, parked inside their short masters with no room bus.
shared_dna.dynamics: Everyday X uses approved source level; a sub-180 ms rapid run follows 1.0/0.93/0.93/0.885 and clears the motif.

mix.rapid_policy: The active stable-screen eligibility clock advances only at 180–700 ms and clears on a screen change. Any interval below 180 ms aborts the rare motif; the armed D5-through-rapid burst uses 1.0, 0.93, 0.93, 0.885, and 0.885 gains and later eligible events stay plain without catch-up.
mix.ducking_policy: Completion clears the rare phrase immediately; a newer ordinary X may steal only an older resonance tail, never its own X core.
silence_policy: cancel or dismiss without a commit
mix.compound_outcome_rule: An action emits one X cue or the atomic locked completion plan, never both independently.
mix.voice_stealing_rule: At the two-voice cap, completion has priority and drops rare resonance tails first.
mix.state_dedupe_rule: State-transition IDs dedupe callbacks independently from the active-screen eligibility clock, screen limit, and global cooldown.
mix.settings_rule: Respect sound disabled, native silent behavior, external audio mixing, and reduced-feedback settings before scheduling.
